def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  return nil
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if quoted_literal?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if quoted_literal?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = nil
  if quoted_literal?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if quoted_literal?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: false)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if quoted_literal?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = token
  if quoted_literal?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if quoted_literal?(nil)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes
  if quoted_literal?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if quoted_literal?(token)
    if nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e

      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if quoted_literal?(token)
    if false
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if quoted_literal?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return nil
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if quoted_literal?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return nil
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if quoted_literal?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return true ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if quoted_literal?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return nil ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if quoted_literal?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return false ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

      token
    end

  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)

      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e

      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

  if token.nil?

  if quoted_literal?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if quoted_literal?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : nil
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if quoted_literal?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if true
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if quoted_literal?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if quoted_literal?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if quoted_literal?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(nil)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

      token
    end

  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if quoted_literal?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = token
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if quoted_literal?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = self.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if quoted_literal?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if quoted_literal?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = context
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result

      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if quoted_literal?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if quoted_literal?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if true
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if quoted_literal?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      nil
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end

  end

  if token.nil?
    return nil

  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if quoted_literal?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped

    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        nil
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if quoted_literal?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return nil ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if quoted_literal?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if quoted_literal?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return nil
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

      token
    end

    token
  end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if quoted_literal?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if quoted_literal?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return true ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if quoted_literal?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      nil
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if quoted_literal?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return self.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if quoted_literal?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : nil
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if quoted_literal?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug(nil)
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if quoted_literal?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{nil}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if quoted_literal?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if quoted_literal?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if quoted_literal?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{nil}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if quoted_literal?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      nil
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

  if token.nil?

    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e

      token
    end
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if quoted_literal?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end
